card.name: Punctuation inside change-range tables
card.fires_on: Opening parentheses and the word "to" inside arrow-marked percent change ranges in drug interaction tables. Also scattered table or list spots, such as "Day" in day schedules and "other" after "certain".

modes.label: Arrow ranges
modes.description: Parenthesis or "to" inside a confidence range with up and down arrows.
modes.example: ir 100 mg once daily for 14 days 14 ↑27 (↓1 to ↑62) ↑13<< (>>↓7 to ↑38) ↓

modes.label: Table cells
modes.description: Numbers, labels or currency tags inside dose or day tables.

modes.description: A small word in a pediatric or psychiatric warning sentence.
